alerts.message: Random synthetic vector incident: Qdrant payload or embedding dimension should be checked.
alerts.recommended_action: Verify vector dimension, payload safety flags, and collection counts.

docker_port_notes.note: The console defaults to 8011 to avoid Postgres, Qdrant, Chroma, and Open WebUI ports.

answer_gate.label: Answer gate
answer_gate.message: Synthetic answer-gate issue: final answer claim must be blocked until citations pass.
answer_gate.recommended_action: Check final answer gate, uncited claims, authority, and leak counters.

community_graph.label: Graph community
community_graph.message: Synthetic community issue: community hint must remain advisory-only.
community_graph.recommended_action: Check community overlay and confirm community is not used as proof.

feedback_memory.label: Feedback memory
feedback_memory.message: Synthetic feedback issue: feedback memory requires review before advisory use.
feedback_memory.recommended_action: Sanitize feedback and confirm it remains advisory-only.

graph_integrity.label: Graph integrity
graph_integrity.message: Synthetic graph issue: possible orphan edge or missing graph lineage.
graph_integrity.recommended_action: Run graph quality checks and block writeback until orphan edges are resolved.

human_review.label: Human review
human_review.message: Synthetic human-review issue: triage card needs reviewer action.
human_review.recommended_action: Open review triage and record a safe reviewer decision.

incremental_ops.label: Incremental ops
incremental_ops.message: Synthetic incremental issue: changed files need dependency-aware rerun planning.
incremental_ops.recommended_action: Inspect manifest/orchestrator dirty pages and avoid full rescan.

keyword_search.label: Keyword / OpenSearch
keyword_search.message: Synthetic keyword-search issue: OpenSearch index document needs validation.
keyword_search.recommended_action: Verify index documents are safe, traced, and not raw OCR/feedback/model output.

llm_advisory.label: LLM advisory
llm_advisory.message: Synthetic LLM advisory issue: model output must remain non-authoritative.
llm_advisory.recommended_action: Ensure LLM output is advisory and final gate controls user-facing claims.

ocr_text.label: OCR text
ocr_text.message: Synthetic OCR issue: OCR quality may be weak or missing on a page.
ocr_text.recommended_action: Schedule OCR cleanup or region OCR retry through fishnet.

page_registry.label: Page registry
page_registry.message: Synthetic page-registry issue: page route/trait classification needs review.
page_registry.recommended_action: Inspect page traits, detected elements, and route recommendations.

retrieval.label: Retrieval
retrieval.message: Synthetic retrieval issue: ranking or evidence grouping needs validation.
retrieval.recommended_action: Run retrieval smoke/regression and inspect citation/trust groups.

security_leakage.label: Security / leakage
security_leakage.message: Synthetic leakage issue: possible local path, raw byte, or prompt/debug leak.
security_leakage.recommended_action: Block publication and run snippet/leakage cleaners before exposure.

semantic_vector.label: Semantic vector / Qdrant
semantic_vector.message: Synthetic vector issue: embedding or Qdrant payload should be checked.
semantic_vector.recommended_action: Verify vector dimension, payload safety flags, and collection counts.

source_ingest.label: Source ingest
source_ingest.message: Synthetic source-ingest issue: a new source file needs trace validation.
source_ingest.recommended_action: Check source manifest, page mapping, and source trace before promotion.

table_extraction.label: Table extraction
table_extraction.message: Synthetic table issue: normalized rows/cells need table repair review.
table_extraction.recommended_action: Review table rows/cells and compare part numbers against catalog/graph.

trust_authority.label: Trust authority
trust_authority.message: Synthetic trust-authority issue: evidence authority must be checked.
trust_authority.recommended_action: Verify trust tier, authority, citation, and allowed-use fields.

visual_diagram.label: Visual / diagram
visual_diagram.message: Synthetic visual issue: callout or visual part candidate needs verification.
visual_diagram.recommended_action: Verify callouts against OCR, table rows, catalog, graph, and source page.

incidents.message: Random synthetic vector incident: Qdrant payload or embedding dimension should be checked.
incidents.recommended_action: Verify vector dimension, payload safety flags, and collection counts.
